title: decision: git_store write_blob .lock().unwrap() is correct for Mutex
description: In post/git_store.rs, write_blob and read_blob call repo.lock().unwrap() inside spawn_blocking closures. Mutex::lock() returns Err only if another thread panicked while holding the lock (poisoned). In spawn_blocking, a panic aborts that blocking task; the JoinError propagates up as an IpfsWriteError. The unwrap on lock is therefore correct: if the mutex is poisoned something has already gone wrong and propagating the panic is the right response.
